result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations of first and second variations (operators $\delta$, $\delta'$, $d$) of the quadratic differential form $(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)^2+c\,ds_2\,ds_3$-type expressions, apparently deriving integrability or invariance conditions on the coefficients $a,b,c$ for Riemann's heat-conduction prize problem.
result.transcription:
$\delta(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)^2+2\delta(c\,ds_2\,ds_3)-2d[-\delta-](ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)(\delta s_1+a\,\delta s_2+b\,\delta s_3)-2d(c\,ds_2\,\delta s_3+\delta s_2\,ds_3)$
$2(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial s_1}ds_2+\frac{\partial b}{\partial s_1}ds_3\right)-2d(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)=0$
$2(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial s_2}ds_2+\frac{\partial b}{\partial s_2}ds_3\right)+2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}ds_2\,ds_3-2d(a(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3))-2d(c\,ds_3)$
$2(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial s_3}ds_2+\frac{\partial b}{\partial s_3}ds_3\right)+2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}ds_2\,ds_3-2d(b(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3))-2d(c\,ds_2)$
$\delta'(c\,ds_2\,\delta s_3+c\,\delta s_2\,ds_3)-\delta(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)(\delta' s_1+a\,\delta' s_2+b\,\delta' s_3)-\delta(c\,ds_2\,\delta' s_3+c\,ds_3\,\delta' s_2)$
$-d(\delta s_1+a\,\delta s_2+b\,\delta s_3)(\delta' s_1+a\,\delta' s_2+b\,\delta' s_3)-d(c\,\delta s_2\,\delta' s_3+c\,\delta s_3\,\delta' s_2)$ $=0$
$c\,d^2 s_3+\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}ds_3^2$ [?]
$\delta(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)+d(\delta s_1+a\,\delta s_2+b\,\delta s_3)=0$
$\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}(ds_2\,\delta s_3+\delta s_2\,ds_3)-\delta(c\,ds_3)-d(c\,\delta s_3)=0$ $2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}ds_3\,\delta s_3+2c\,d\delta s_3=0$

methods.what: First variation of a quadratic differential form with integration by parts (Euler–Lagrange-type expression)
Component equation (coefficient of $\delta s_1$) of the variational equations
Second (mixed) variation with two variations $\delta,\delta'$ set to zero
methods.quote: $\delta'(c\,ds_2\,\delta s_3+c\,\delta s_2\,ds_3)-\delta(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)(\delta' s_1+a\,\delta' s_2+b\,\delta' s_3)-\delta(c\,ds_2\,\delta' s_3+c\,ds_3\,\delta' s_2)$

methods.what: Conditions from variations: commutation-type relations for the linear form and coefficient $c$
